quote: “Our battered suitcases were piled on the sidewalk again; we had longer ways to go. But no matter, the road is life.”
source: Jack Kerouac, On the Road, Part Three, ch. 5 (Sal Paradise)
speaker: Sal Paradise

evidence.where: LitCharts and Course Hero chapter summaries of Part 3, Chapter 5 both place “the road is life” there, at the Denver drop-off; wording checked against the standard quotation of the Viking 1957 text (Goodreads and other quotation sites agree letter for letter); no primary scan was reachable
evidence.edition: On the Road, Viking Press, 1957 (Penguin reprints keep the text)
evidence.locator: Part Three, chapter 5, Sal and Dean set down in Denver

reason: The sentence is the narrator Sal Paradise’s, in Part Three, chapter 5, as two independent chapter guides confirm and as I recall the Viking text; the wording is the one every reference gives, but I could not open a primary copy, so confidence stays medium rather than high.
